demos.placeholderDescription: Placeholder: creates the initial globe; the feature example is pending.
demos.visualizationScaffoldDescription: Scaffold only: data, visualization and controls are left for implementation.
demos.initialViewDescription: Set the initial camera position and orientation through homeView, using degrees or radians.
demos.startAnimationDescription: Enable or disable the startup animation using a dropdown that recreates Earth on change.
demos.mouseEventsDescription: Listen for mouse button, click, double-click, move and wheel events, inspect their parameters, and unsubscribe.
demos.cameraEventsDescription: Listen for camera changes, movement and flight events, inspect the current view, and try flight cancellation and unsubscribing.
demos.resourceEventsDescription: Listen for imagery addition, removal, visibility and property changes, adjust opacity, and stop listening.
demos.pickingHighlightDescription: Pick objects, highlight hover and selection, inspect properties, restore styles, and pause interaction while drawing.
demos.resourceTreeDescription: Control resource loading, visibility, basemaps and terrain; reorder resources and save, import or export the tree layout.
demos.poiDescription: Generate a soldier pin and load it through the POI resource API; locate, toggle visibility, resize, remove, and reload it.
demos.singleImageDescription: Place a single image within geographic bounds, then load, locate, show or hide it, adjust opacity, and remove it.
demos.xyzDescription: Load OSM and CyclOSM XYZ 3857 tiles, switch maps, adjust visibility and opacity, remove layers, and inspect tile errors.
demos.geojsonDescription: Load local Hefei road GeoJSON as ground-clamped lines, then locate, show or hide, remove, and reload the data.
demos.gltfModelDescription: Load a local helicopter GLB, locate it from an oblique view, toggle visibility and animations, adjust scale and heading, remove, and reload it.
demos.tilesetDescription: Load the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda 3D Tiles from a self-hosted service; locate, toggle visibility and bounds, adjust detail, monitor tile loading, remove, and reload.
demos.drawPointDescription: Draw points with cursor previews, complete or cancel, choose coordinate formats and point styles, remove the last point, and clear results.
demos.drawPolylineDescription: Draw polylines with vertex and segment previews, right-click completion, cancellation, coordinate formats, line styles, ground clamping, and result cleanup.
demos.drawPolygonDescription: Draw and retain a polygon, finish with a right click or the End button, and log the result to the console.
demos.drawRectangleDescription: Draw and retain a rectangle with two clicks and log its four corners to the console.
demos.drawCircleDescription: Draw and retain a circle with two clicks and log its center, edge point and radius to the console.
demos.measureDescription: Measure with the SDK, retain result entities and labels, and log the returned data to the console.
demos.overviewDescription: Open, hide and close the overview map; synchronize the main view and navigate by clicking or dragging its footprint.
demos.coordinateStatusDescription: Display mouse coordinates, camera position and orientation, and FPS using SDK data APIs.
demos.navigationDescription: Show the compass, zoom controls and scale bar together; configure position, feature switches, reset view and flight duration.
demos.lifecycleDescription: Listen for creation, readiness, page pause and resume, and destruction lifecycle events.
demos.configDescription: Adjust the initial view and startup options, then apply them to recreate the globe.
demos.basicDescription: Edit HTML and view the result in the preview.
demos.interactionDescription: Try JavaScript interactions, rerun and reset.
demos.visualizationBasicsDescription: Display points, billboards, polylines, polygons, rectangles and circles with live style controls, filtering and layer lifecycle actions.
demos.visualizationLinesDescription: Compare 14 built-in and animated line materials; adjust color, width, duration, repetition and direction, pause playback or inspect one material.
demos.visualizationAreasDescription: Compare gradient materials on Entity and Primitive geometries; switch shapes and adjust center/edge opacity, color and height.
demos.visualizationMarkersDescription: Display points, text, icons and combined markers together.
demos.visualizationHtmlLabelsDescription: Display all HTML label themes, custom content and water gauges together.
demos.visualizationPopupsDescription: Compare three popup styles and three collapsible panel styles.
demos.visualizationMotionMarkersDescription: Compare repeating bounce, settling bounce and floating markers.
demos.visualizationVideoMarkersDescription: Display a playable, collapsible geographic video marker.
demos.visualizationClustersDescription: Compare count circles with count-based cluster icons.
demos.visualizationThematicMigrationDescriptio: Switch between ECharts migration, inflow, outflow and MapV migration using nationwide city data.
demos.visualizationThematicScatterDescription: Switch between city scatter points, ripple effects and highlighted cities using the same data.
demos.visualizationThematicHeatmapDescription: Compare three heatmap.js render modes and MapV heatmaps using the same nationwide sample points.
demos.visualizationThematicAggregationDescript: Compare square-grid and honeycomb aggregation using the same nationwide sample points.
demos.visualizationThematicRegionsDescription: Display administrative regions with fills, boundaries, gradients, extrusions and textured walls.
demos.visualizationVideoProjectionDescription: Project a local video onto the ground and building surfaces, with playback, projection visibility and frustum controls.
